name: Cush (son of Ham, father of Nimrod)
title: Ancestor of the Cushites
summary: Cush was one of Ham's sons and a grandson of Noah. He is best known as the father of Nimrod, the mighty hunter and founder of great cities. Cush became the ancestor of the peoples who settled in the regions south of Egypt, what later came to be known as Ethiopia/Nubia.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy after the flood
keyEvents.description: Cush is mentioned as the first of Ham's four sons in the genealogy that describes how the earth was populated after the flood.

keyEvents.title: The Sons and Descendants of Cush
keyEvents.description: The Bible lists Cush's six sons, who became the ancestors of various peoples in Africa and Arabia.

keyEvents.title: Father of Nimrod
keyEvents.description: Cush had a son named Nimrod, who became the first mighty ruler on earth and founded great cities such as Babel and Nineveh.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Cush's lineage is confirmed in the great genealogy in 1 Chronicles.
